subject: [PATCH 1/2] perf/x86/amd/uncore: Remove redundant event slot scan

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch removes a redundant scan in the perf/x86/amd/uncore code, which checks if an event is already assigned to a slot before searching for a free one. The patch takes advantage of the fact that the perf_event_add and perf_event_del functions serialize access to events, ensuring that an existing assignment will always be at the recorded index. This optimization reduces the number of times the code needs to scan all counters, which can lead to performance improvements in scenarios where the amd_uncore_add function is called frequently, such as during CPU context migration or multiplexing.
